notes: DiscoFlate v3.57.0 — Commands and Events merge into one TRIGGERS tab of collapsible sections; rows open by clicking their title strip (the ✏️ button is gone). Scenes gain Solid and Audio overlays, ▶ Move To, scene + group duplicate, intro-flagged groups, and a canvas that previews at the virtual cam's real resolution. Go Live plays a CHAIN of intro stages. Every command can put its own line on one shared notify overlay, and pausing covers the stream with a pause card. Turning a scene group off now means off the STREAM — firing it still plays it. The Camera tab is gone (the snapshot action already posts the composited frame). Chat renders Discord formatting.
